# HL7 v2.5.1 ORU^R01 OBX Fields

In an HL7 v2.5.1 ORU^R01 message:

## Observation Value
**OBX-5 (Observation Value)** carries the actual observation/result value.

## Data Type Declaration
**OBX-2 (Value Type)** declares the data type of that value.

### Example:
```
OBX|1|NM|2345-7^Glucose^LN||95|mg/dL|70-100|N|||F
     ^              ^
    OBX-2        OBX-5
   (Value Type)  (Observation Value)
```

In this example:
- **OBX-2 = "NM"** specifies the data type is Numeric
- **OBX-5 = "95"** contains the actual glucose value

Common OBX-2 values include: **NM** (numeric), **ST** (string), **CE** (coded entry), **TX** (text), **DT** (date), **TM** (time), and others depending on the observation type.
